sources.title: Yewandou7/spatial_umi_dream - GitHub
sources.snippet: Spatial-UMI-Dream is a 5B spatial world action model for UMI manipulation. It is pretrained on 605 hours of RGB-D UMI data and jointly predicts future RGB, metric depth and actions. Stereo metric depth is aligned with the native fisheye RGB of each gripper, and both grippers share one RGB-D video canvas, so the video model sees geometry in pixel space.
